properties.name: chart.categorical.max-categories
properties.description: Maximum number of categories kept in a categorical distribution result before the rest are merged into a single 'Other' bucket. Maps from the CHART_MAX_CATEGORIES environment variable.

properties.name: logging.audit.api-key
properties.description: API key sent with each audit log event to the logging service. Maps from the LOGGING_API_KEY environment variable. When this and logging.audit.url are both blank, LoggingClientBean builds a no-op logging client and audit logging is disabled.

properties.name: logging.audit.url
properties.description: Base URL of the audit logging service that receives query and request events. Maps from the LOGGING_SERVICE_URL environment variable. When this and logging.audit.api-key are both blank, LoggingClientBean builds a no-op logging client and audit logging is disabled.

properties.name: picsure.query-service.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of pic-sure-hpds-query-service, the single HPDS ingress this service posts distribution sub-queries to. Maps from the HPDS_QUERY_SERVICE_URL environment variable, with application.properties defaulting it to http://pic-sure-hpds-query-service:8080.

properties.name: rest-template.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout, in milliseconds, for the shared RestClient used to call downstream services. Maps from the REST_TEMPLATE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT environment variable, with application.properties defaulting it to 5000.

properties.name: rest-template.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout, in milliseconds, for the shared RestClient used to call downstream services. Maps from the REST_TEMPLATE_READ_TIMEOUT environment variable, with application.properties defaulting it to 30000.
